src='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            for y, x in q:
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] != bg:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            components.append(q)
    source = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in source)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in source)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in source)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in source)
    pattern = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c])
               for r in range(r0, r1+1) for c in range(c0, c1+1)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and (r, c) in set(source)]
    anchors = [p[0] for comp in components if comp is not source for p in comp]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in anchors:
        out[r][c] = bg
    ar, ac = (r1-r0)//2, (c1-c0)//2
    for r, c in anchors:
        top, left = r-ar, c-ac
        for dy, dx, value in pattern:
            y, x = top+dy, left+dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = value
    return out
'''
